in_marathi.name: Chandramohan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God (Chandra) + Mind (Mana) + God (Ishvara) + Self (Atman)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandramohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandramohan is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. The first part of the name, 'Chandra', refers to the moon god. The second part, 'Mohan', is a combination of 'Mana' and 'Ishvara', which means mind and god, respectively. The name can be interpreted as 'one who captivates the mind with the divine'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture to signify a deep connection to the divine.
